verdict.rationale: Spline documents an MCP server bundled with the desktop app and a Real-time API/webhooks system, but nothing in the evidence describes issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials/tokens for an agent — access is described as auto-registering with detected clients, not permissioned key issuance. missing for 10: any mention of API key/token scoping, permission levels, or least-privilege credential management for agent access.
